name: @kanzo-tech/palette
description: Kanzo colour derivation — ramps, the categorical search, the role table and the compiler that turns two seeds into a tenant palette document. Authoring-time only: nothing here runs in a browser.

scripts.//gen: The tables the derivation reads, then the build that makes the derivation runnable from plain Node. `@kanzo-tech/theme`'s own `gen` runs this first.

//deps: No runtime dependencies and no consumers at runtime. `tailwindcss` is read by scripts/gen-data.mjs for its palette, never imported by src.
